models_evaluated: deep learning-based CAD system for chest radiographs

links.outcome: Radiologist sensitivity and specificity with versus without CAD assistance
links.effect: CAD-assisted interpretation had higher sensitivity (81.8% vs. 72.7%; P=0.046) but lower specificity (84.1% vs. 85.7%; P<0.001) than radiologists alone.
links.quote: The CAD-assisted interpretation exhibited a higher sensitivity (81.8% vs. 72.7%; P =0.046) but lower specificity than the radiologists' interpretation (84.1% vs. 85.7%; P <0.001).

links.outcome: CAD sensitivity versus radiologists on the same data in reader test
links.effect: CAD sensitivity 72.7% vs. radiologists 59.5% (P=0.005) at the same specificity of 88.0%.
links.quote: In the reader test, the CAD exhibited a higher sensitivity than radiologists (72.7% vs. 59.5%; P =0.005) at the same specificity (88.0%), and CAD-assisted interpretation significantly improved the sensitivity of radiologists' interpretation (72.3%; P <0.001).

links.outcome: Radiologist performance with versus without CAD
links.effect: Sensitivity increased 81.8% vs. 72.7% (P =0.046); specificity decreased 84.1% vs. 85.7% (P <0.001).
links.quote: The CAD-assisted interpretation exhibited a higher sensitivity (81.8% vs. 72.7%; P =0.046) but lower specificity than the radiologists' interpretation (84.1% vs. 85.7%; P <0.001).

links.effect: CAD sensitivity 72.7% vs. radiologists 59.5% (P =0.005) at specificity 88.0%.
links.quote: In the reader test, the CAD exhibited a higher sensitivity than radiologists (72.7% vs. 59.5%; P =0.005) at the same specificity (88.0%), and CAD-assisted interpretation significantly improved the sensitivity of radiologists' interpretation (72.3%; P <0.001).

links.outcome: Prescreening versus radiologist interpretation of all cases
links.effect: Specificity 88.8% vs. 85.7% (P <0.001) at same sensitivity; workload reduced 85.2% (1780 to 263).
links.quote: The CAD-based prescreening exhibited a higher specificity than the radiologists' interpretation (88.8% vs. 85.7%; P <0.001) at the same sensitivity, with a workload reduction of 85.2% (1780 to 263).
